key.name: toggle-launcher
key.description: Keybinding to open/close the launcher popup. Defaults to Ctrl+Alt+Space to avoid colliding with GNOME's own Super+Space (input source switcher).

key.name: icon-scale
key.description: Multiplier applied to every icon size across all layouts. 1.0 is the default size.

key.name: background-opacity
key.description: Opacity of launcher backgrounds (1.0 opaque, 0.0 fully transparent). Lower values let Blur My Shell blur show through. Applies to all layouts.
